title: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub code scanning's AI Scan for pull requests can now be managed via organization and repository REST APIs, enabling programmatic rollout while preserving organization-level disabled precedence.
actionable_takeaway: Create an AI Scan rollout receipt that records org and repo state, GHAS eligibility, GitHub.com-only support, before/after reads, and rollback commands.

title: Control GitHub Actions cache access with cache-mode
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Actions workflows and jobs can now explicitly set cache access to read, write, write-only, or none, reducing cache poisoning risk and carrying least-privilege access through reusable workflows.
actionable_takeaway: Audit pull_request_target, fork PR, trusted push, and reusable workflows; require explicit cache-mode and reviewer approval for low-trust write access.

title: Refreshed repository pull requests page in public preview
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: The new repository PR page adds content assist, advanced search, compact presentation, status check counts, stack indicators, and unread indicators that can improve agent-generated PR triage.
actionable_takeaway: Use the preview as a triage surface for agent PR queues, but keep final acceptance tied to diff review, tests, rulesets, and reviewer decisions.

title: MAI-Code-1-Flash deprecated across GitHub Copilot experiences
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub deprecated MAI-Code-1-Flash across Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions, with MAI-Code-1.1-Flash as the suggested alternative.
actionable_takeaway: Scan Copilot workflows, enterprise model policies, IDE defaults, and documentation for deprecated model names before assuming model selectors are healthy.

title: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub-hosted macOS runners can validate Apple apps against macOS 27 through the Xcode 27 runner image on arm64 runners in public preview.
actionable_takeaway: Add a macOS 27/Xcode 27 CI lane for Apple automation and record runner architecture, installed toolchain, and preview rollback boundaries.

title: OpenAI Codex Python SDK 0.154.0 adds ExternalMessage and turn controls
author: OpenAI Codex contributors
why_it_matters: Codex Python SDK 0.154.0 adds max and ultra reasoning efforts, ExternalMessage, include_turns, per-turn service tier, source metadata, typed notification payloads, and migration notes for hook metadata and late turn handles.
actionable_takeaway: Test ExternalMessage as tool-level authority that does not grant user authorization, and separate include_turns history reads from model-context changes.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0 alpha lane continues
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.0 alpha releases appeared after the stable 0.154.0 line, indicating active preview churn while public behavioral notes remain minimal.
actionable_takeaway: Keep 0.155.0 in an alpha observation lane and do not replace stable defaults without a fixed smoke suite and explicit approval.

title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.15.0 adds Agents API
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: The Node SDK added generated Agents API support, moving agent primitives closer to the main JavaScript production SDK path.
actionable_takeaway: Add Node Agents API smoke tests for creation, tool calls, permission failures, tracing fields, and parity with Python.

title: OpenAI Node SDK 7.14.0 adds Live API
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: The Node SDK added Live API support, making realtime interactions a first-class generated SDK surface for JavaScript applications.
actionable_takeaway: Run Live API smoke tests for connection, cancellation, stream cleanup, and error shape before upgrading realtime workflows.

title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.13.0 adds Agents API
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: The Python SDK added generated Agents API support on the same day as the Node SDK, signaling main-SDK convergence for agent capabilities.
actionable_takeaway: Decide which automations use openai-python Agents API versus openai-agents-python, and record migration boundaries.

title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.12.0 adds Live API and AsyncStream cleanup
author: OpenAI / openai-sdks[bot]
why_it_matters: The Python SDK added Live API plus AsyncStream aclose cleanup and output-preservation fixes, which matter for long-running realtime automations.
actionable_takeaway: Include AsyncStream cleanup, null response completion, and bare dict/list annotation cases in Python Live API upgrade tests.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.84-4 prerelease updates plugin, MCP, skill, and sandbox behavior
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The prerelease adds new list and JSON commands, replaces plugin enable/disable spelling, improves sandbox current-session status, and changes skill install commands.
actionable_takeaway: Update CLI prerelease smoke tests for command migration, JSON output, sandbox status, indexed search, and removed command spellings before changing docs.
